daily_briefing:
The most important story today is the release of santifer/career-ops, an open-source AI tool that evaluates job listings from various portals and provides a structured report along with a global score. This development matters significantly as it empowers users to tailor their resumes more effectively and track applications in a more organized manner, potentially enhancing their job search process.

Following closely is the ggml/llama.cpp project's release of version b10603, which introduces support for MTP in GLM-4.5-Air (#26534). This update is crucial as it enhances the library’s functionality, particularly on macOS, making it a valuable resource for developers working with this technology.

Readers should keep an eye on future updates from both projects, especially any improvements to accuracy and performance in ggml/llama.cpp, which could significantly impact how AI tools are used in various applications.
